Firefox will automatically add and sync your logins if you've enabled logins sync (see [[How to perform Sync on Firefox desktop]]). You can also add logins to Firefox, if you prefer, by following these steps:
{for not fx122}
#Click the Firefox menu [[Image:Fx89menuButton]] button and select {menu Passwords}.
#*The Firefox ''about:logins'' page will open.
#Click the {for not fx111}{button Create New Login} button at the bottom{/for}{for fx111}{button +} button next to the ''Search Logins'' box at the top{/for} left side of the ''about:logins'' page.
#;{for not fx111}[[Image:Fx96aboutlogins|width=600]]{/for}{for fx111}[[Image:Fx115AboutLogins]]{/for}
#Enter the website address, username and password for that site.
#Click {button Save}.
{/for}
{for fx122}
#Click the Firefox menu [[Image:Fx89menuButton]] button and select {menu Passwords}.
#*The Firefox ''about:logins'' page will open.
#Click the {button +} button next to the ''Search Passwords'' box at the top left side of the page.
#;[[Image:Fx122AboutLogins]]
#Enter the website address, username and password for that site.
#;[[Image:add password page|width=500]]
#Click [[Image:save button|width=80]].
{/for}
To learn more about managing logins in Firefox, see [[Password Manager - Remember, delete and edit logins and passwords in Firefox]].
